text:
Emma (AE): Kicking off thread for AcmeBank POC — they want strict regional control + subproc list for EMEA + APAC. Can we confirm available regions and any gov-cloud gaps?
Raj (Presales): They also asked about routing policy: tenant pinning vs fallthrough. What's recommended for lowest latency and compliance?
Linda (Security): Need to know which sub-processors touch plaintext. Also BYOK/KMS options and which regions have HSM-backed KMS.
Oliver (SRE): Quick answers: hosted API regions: eu-west-1, eu-west-2, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1. No gov-cloud in APAC yet. Dedicated can be provisioned in customer VPCs in eu-west-1 & eu-central-1.
Carla (Solutions): For tenant pinning we can do per-tenant geofence + sticky routing. Fallback policy can be set to 'same-region-fallback' or 'cross-region-failover' — the latter needs signed SLA caveat.
Emma (AE): Pricing flag — AcmeBank expects EMEA-only routing. How does that impact hosted pricing / egress assumptions?
Raj (Presales): EMEA-only increases egress ops - can approximate +15-25% unit cost on hosted. Dedicated quote will be cleaner (fixed commit). I'll draft numbers.
Linda (Security): On sub-processors: need a list for legal. Which third parties are in the call path for eu regions? Specifically KMS, logging, and telemetry.
Oliver (SRE): Subproc summary: KMS: our KMS partner in eu-west is KeySafeEU (managed HSM); Logging: LogStream (EU-only cluster); Monitoring/telemetry: MetricsCorp (EU region shard). I'll attach SOC2/ISO certs later.
Carla (Solutions): For APAC concern: if their data is strictly EMEA, we can disable APAC routing in tenant policy, but note model catalog differences (some smaller quantized variants only in select regions).
Emma (AE): Legal asked for a one-pager we can hand to customer w/region list, subproc names, BYOK flow, and fallover behavior. Can someone own the doc?
Raj (Presales): I'll own the one-pager. Linda — can you provide the exact subproc contact & cert links? Oliver — any network diagram for tenant pinning?
Linda (Security): I'll collate subproc attestation + cert URLs by EOD. FYI some certs are on internal S3; I'll share a pre-signed link.
Oliver (SRE): Will export a simple network diagram and sample iptables/cidr routing snippet for the pinned path. Example snippet:
```
route_policy:
  tenant_pin: true
  allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
  fallback: same-region-fallback
```
Carla (Solutions): Also raise: BYOK key import timelines — if they want customer KMS in own account it can add ~2 weeks to POC.
Emma (AE): Good call. I'll inform AcmeBank of the potential 2-week lead on BYOK and that Dedicated shortens uncertainty on egress pricing.
deploy-bot: Deployment job #5821 completed: prod-region-metadata refreshed (169k models indexed) :white_check_mark:
Raj (Presales): Next steps: I'll produce the one-pager + draft quote (hosted vs dedicated). Linda & Oliver to attach links. Emma to sync with customer and escalate timeline if they need BYOK.
Emma (AE): Thanks team — ping me in thread when docs are up. I'll schedule a 30m sync with AcmeBank for Thursday.
